verses.original: שָׁל֔וֹשׁ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת לְמַלְכ֖וּת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lō·wōš biš·naṯ lə·mal·ḵūṯ ham·me·leḵ bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar ḥā·zō·wn nir·’āh ’ê·lay ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl ’a·ḥă·rê han·nir·’āh ’ê·lay bat·tə·ḥil·lāh
verses.literal: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar a vision appeared to me . . . Daniel subsequent to the one that had appeared to me earlier

verses.original: בֶּחָזוֹן֒ וָֽאֶרְאֶה֮ וַיְהִי֙ בִּרְאֹתִ֔י וַאֲנִי֙ הַבִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַמְּדִינָ֑ה בְּעֵילָ֣ם וָאֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽחָז֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל־ אוּלָֽי׃ אוּבַ֥ל
verses.transliteration: be·ḥā·zō·wn wā·’er·’eh way·hî bir·’ō·ṯî wa·’ă·nî hab·bî·rāh ’ă·šer bə·šū·šan ham·mə·ḏî·nāh bə·‘ê·lām wā·’er·’eh be·ḥā·zō·wn wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî ‘al- ’ū·lāy ’ū·ḇal
verses.literal: And in the vision I saw myself in the citadel - of Susa in the province of Elam I saw in the vision that I was beside the Ulai Canal

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ אֶחָ֗ד אַ֣יִל וְל֣וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם עֹמֵ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֻבָ֖ל וְהַקְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְהָאַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן־ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית וְהַ֨גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eś·śā ‘ê·nay wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh ’e·ḥāḏ ’a·yil wə·lōw qə·rā·nā·yim ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê hā·’u·ḇāl wə·haq·qə·rā·na·yim gə·ḇō·hō·wṯ wə·hā·’a·ḥaṯ gə·ḇō·hāh min- haš·šê·nîṯ wə·hag·gə·ḇō·hāh ‘ō·lāh bā·’a·ḥă·rō·nāh
verses.literal: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw - - a ram with two horns standing beside the canal The horns were long but one was longer than the other and the longer one grew up later

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־ הָאַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּחַ֩ יָ֨מָּה וְצָפ֜וֹנָה וָנֶ֗גְבָּה וְכָל־ לֹֽא־ חַיּוֹת֙ יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִיָּד֑וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה כִרְצֹנ֖וֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·’a·yil mə·nag·gê·aḥ yām·māh wə·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wā·neḡ·bāh wə·ḵāl lō- ḥay·yō·wṯ ya·‘am·ḏū lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl mî·yā·ḏōw wə·‘ā·śāh ḵir·ṣō·nōw wə·hiḡ·dîl
verses.literal: I saw - the ram charging toward the west and the north and the south No . . . animal could stand against him and there was no deliverance from his power He did as he pleased and became great

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְהִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר־ וְהַ֨צָּפִ֔יר חָז֖וּת קֶ֥רֶן בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽיו׃ הָֽעִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן־ הַֽמַּעֲרָב֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hā·yî·ṯî mê·ḇîn wə·hin·nêh ṣə·p̄îr- wə·haṣ·ṣā·p̄îr ḥā·zūṯ qe·ren bên ‘ê·nāw hā·‘iz·zîm bā min- ham·ma·‘ă·rāḇ ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên nō·w·ḡê·a‘ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: As I was contemplating all this suddenly a goat - with a prominent horn between his eyes . . . came out of the west crossing the surface of the entire earth without touching the ground

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗א עַד־ הַקְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָאַ֙יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֻבָ֑ל וַיָּ֥רָץ אֵלָ֖יו בַּחֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- haq·qə·rā·na·yim ’ă·šer hā·’a·yil ba·‘al rā·’î·ṯî ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê hā·’u·ḇāl way·yā·rāṣ ’ê·lāw ba·ḥă·maṯ kō·ḥōw
verses.literal: He came toward the two-horned - ram . . . I had seen standing beside the canal and rushed at him with furious power

verses.original: וּרְאִיתִ֞יו מַגִּ֣יעַ׀ אֵ֣צֶל הָאַ֗יִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־ הָאַ֔יִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔יו בָּאַ֖יִל הָ֥יָה וְלֹא־ כֹ֛חַ לַעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤הוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַֽיִּרְמְסֵ֔הוּ הָיָ֥ה וְלֹא־ מַצִּ֛יל לָאַ֖יִל מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’î·ṯîw mag·gî·a‘ ’ê·ṣel hā·’a·yil way·yiṯ·mar·mar ’ê·lāw way·yaḵ ’eṯ- hā·’a·yil way·šab·bêr ’eṯ- šə·tê qə·rā·nāw bā·’a·yil hā·yāh wə·lō- ḵō·aḥ la·‘ă·mōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yaš·lî·ḵê·hū ’ar·ṣāh way·yir·mə·sê·hū hā·yāh wə·lō- maṣ·ṣîl lā·’a·yil mî·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: I saw him approach . . . the ram in a rage against him and he struck - the ram and shattered - his two horns The ram was vvv powerless to stand against him and the goat threw him to the ground and trampled him [and] no one could deliver the ram from his power

verses.original: וּצְפִ֥יר הָעִזִּ֖ים עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד הִגְדִּ֣יל וּכְעָצְמ֗וֹ הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה הַקֶּ֣רֶן נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ אַרְבַּע֙ חָז֤וּת וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֜נָה תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṣə·p̄îr hā·‘iz·zîm ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ hiḡ·dîl ū·ḵə·‘ā·ṣə·mōw hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh haq·qe·ren niš·bə·rāh ’ar·ba‘ ḥā·zūṯ wat·ta·‘ă·le·nāh taḥ·te·hā lə·’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥō·wṯ haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Thus the goat . . . became very great but at the height of his power his large horn was broken off and four prominent horns came up in its place pointing toward the four winds of heaven

verses.original: וּמִן־ הָאַחַ֣ת מֵהֶ֔ם אַחַ֖ת מִצְּעִירָ֑ה קֶֽרֶן־ יָצָ֥א וַתִּגְדַּל־ יֶ֛תֶר אֶל־ הַנֶּ֥גֶב הַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְאֶל־ וְאֶל־ הַצֶּֽבִי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hā·’a·ḥaṯ mê·hem ’a·ḥaṯ miṣ·ṣə·‘î·rāh qe·ren- yā·ṣā wat·tiḡ·dal- ye·ṯer ’el- han·ne·ḡeḇ ham·miz·rāḥ wə·’el- wə·’el- haṣ·ṣe·ḇî
verses.literal: From one of [these horns] a little horn emerged and grew extensively toward the south and the east . . . and toward the Beautiful Land

verses.original: וַתִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתַּפֵּ֥ל מִן־ הַצָּבָ֥א וּמִן־ הַכּוֹכָבִ֖ים אַ֛רְצָה וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḡ·dal ‘aḏ- ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim wat·tap·pêl min- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ū·min- hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’ar·ṣāh wat·tir·mə·sêm
verses.literal: It grew as high as the host of heaven and it cast down some of the host and [some] of the stars to the earth and trampled them

verses.original: הִגְדִּ֑יל וּמִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ וְעַ֥ד שַֽׂר־ הַצָּבָ֖א הֵרִים הַתָּמִ֔יד וְהֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hiḡ·dîl ū·mim·men·nū wə·‘aḏ śar- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā hē·rīm hat·tā·mîḏ wə·huš·laḵ mə·ḵō·wn miq·dā·šōw
verses.literal: It magnified itself . . . even to the Prince of the host it removed His daily sacrifice and overthrew the place of His sanctuary

verses.original: בְּפָ֑שַׁע וְצָבָ֛א עַל־ הַתָּמִ֖יד תִּנָּתֵ֥ן וְתַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃ וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄ā·ša‘ wə·ṣā·ḇā ‘al- hat·tā·mîḏ tin·nā·ṯên wə·ṯaš·lêḵ ’ĕ·meṯ ’ar·ṣāh wə·hiṣ·lî·ḥāh wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh
verses.literal: And in the rebellion the host - [and] the daily sacrifice were given over [to the horn] and it flung truth to the ground and prospered in whatever it did

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמְעָ֥ה אֶֽחָד־ קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י וַיֹּאמֶר֩ הַֽמְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד־ מָתַ֞י הֶחָז֤וֹן הַתָּמִיד֙ וְהַפֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְקֹ֥דֶשׁ וְצָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·mə·‘āh ’e·ḥāḏ- qā·ḏō·wōš mə·ḏab·bêr ’e·ḥāḏ qā·ḏō·wōš lap·pal·mō·w·nî way·yō·mer ham·ḏab·bêr ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay he·ḥā·zō·wn hat·tā·mîḏ wə·hap·pe·ša‘ šō·mêm têṯ wə·qō·ḏeš wə·ṣā·ḇā mir·mās
verses.literal: Then I heard a holy one speaking and another holy . . . one said to [him] How long [until the fulfillment of] the vision of the daily sacrifice the rebellion that causes desolation and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י עַ֚ד אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר קֹֽדֶשׁ׃ וְנִצְדַּ֖ק
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ‘aḏ ’al·pa·yim ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘e·reḇ bō·qer qō·ḏeš wə·niṣ·daq
verses.literal: He said to me It will take 2,300 . . . . . . evenings and mornings then the sanctuary will be properly restored

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת־ בִּרְאֹתִ֛י הֶחָז֑וֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁ֣ה בִינָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְנֶגְדִּ֖י כְּמַרְאֵה־ גָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl ’eṯ- bir·’ō·ṯî he·ḥā·zō·wn wā·’ă·ḇaq·šāh ḇî·nāh wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·mêḏ lə·neḡ·dî kə·mar·’êh- ḡā·ḇer
verses.literal: While I Daniel - was watching the vision and trying to understand it there stood before me one having the appearance of a man

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹל־ אָדָ֖ם וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר בֵּ֣ין אוּלָ֑י גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן הַמַּרְאֶֽה׃ לְהַלָּ֖ז אֶת־
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·ma‘ qō·wl- ’ā·ḏām way·yiq·rā way·yō·mar bên ’ū·lāy gaḇ·rî·’êl hā·ḇên ham·mar·’eh lə·hal·lāz ’eṯ-
verses.literal: And I heard the voice of a man calling . . . from between [the banks of] the Ulai Gabriel explain the vision to this man -

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֵ֣צֶל עָמְדִ֔י וּבְבֹא֣וֹ נִבְעַ֔תִּי וָאֶפְּלָ֖ה עַל־ פָּנָ֑י בֶּן־ אָדָ֔ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ הָבֵ֣ן כִּ֖י הֶחָזֽוֹן׃ לְעֶת־ קֵ֥ץ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ê·ṣel ‘ā·mə·ḏî ū·ḇə·ḇō·’ōw niḇ·‘at·tî wā·’ep·pə·lāh ‘al- pā·nāy ben- ’ā·ḏām way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hā·ḇên kî he·ḥā·zō·wn lə·‘eṯ- qêṣ
verses.literal: As he came near to where I stood I was terrified and fell facedown . . . Son of man he said to me understand that the vision concerns the time of the end

verses.original: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י נִרְדַּ֥מְתִּי עַל־ פָּנַ֖י אָ֑רְצָה וַיִּ֨גַּע־ בִּ֔י וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖נִי עַל־ עָמְדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḏab·bə·rōw ‘im·mî nir·dam·tî ‘al- pā·nay ’ā·rə·ṣāh way·yig·ga‘- bî way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏê·nî ‘al- ‘ā·mə·ḏî
verses.literal: While he was speaking with me I fell into a deep sleep with my face to the ground Then he touched me helped me to my feet . . . . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנְנִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַזָּ֑עַם כִּ֖י לְמוֹעֵ֥ד קֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nî mō·w·ḏî·‘ă·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yih·yeh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ haz·zā·‘am kî lə·mō·w·‘êḏ qêṣ
verses.literal: and said Behold I will make known to you - what will happen in the latter time of wrath because it concerns the appointed time of the end

verses.original: הַקְּרָנָ֑יִם הָאַ֥יִל אֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֖יתָ בַּ֣עַל מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qə·rā·nā·yim hā·’a·yil ’ă·šer- rā·’î·ṯā ba·‘al mal·ḵê mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·rās
verses.literal: The two-horned ram that you saw . . . represents the kings of Media and Persia

verses.original: הַשָּׂעִ֖יר וְהַצָּפִ֥יר מֶ֣לֶךְ יָוָ֑ן הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר וְהַקֶּ֤רֶן בֵּין־ עֵינָ֔יו ה֖וּא הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·‘îr wə·haṣ·ṣā·p̄îr me·leḵ yā·wān hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ’ă·šer wə·haq·qe·ren bên- ‘ê·nāw hū hā·ri·šō·wn ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: The shaggy goat represents the king of Greece and the large - horn between his eyes is the first king

verses.original: אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְהַ֨נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת וַתַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה מִגּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְלֹ֥א בְכֹחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·ba‘ taḥ·te·hā wə·han·niš·be·reṯ ’ar·ba‘ mal·ḵu·yō·wṯ wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh mig·gō·w ya·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh wə·lō ḇə·ḵō·ḥōw
verses.literal: The four [horns] that replaced the broken [one] represent four kingdoms that will rise from that nation . . . but will not have the same power

verses.original: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ם הַפֹּשְׁעִ֑ים כְּהָתֵ֖ם עַז־ פָּנִ֖ים מֶ֥לֶךְ וּמֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת׃ יַעֲמֹ֛ד
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ mal·ḵū·ṯām hap·pō·šə·‘îm kə·hā·ṯêm ‘az- pā·nîm me·leḵ ū·mê·ḇîn ḥî·ḏō·wṯ ya·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: In the latter part of their reign when the rebellion has reached its full measure an insolent . . . king skilled in intrigue will come to the throne

verses.original: כֹּחוֹ֙ וְעָצַ֤ם בְכֹח֔וֹ וְנִפְלָא֥וֹת וְלֹ֣א יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְהִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים קְדֹשִֽׁים׃ וְעַם־
verses.transliteration: kō·ḥōw wə·‘ā·ṣam ḇə·ḵō·ḥōw wə·nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ wə·lō yaš·ḥîṯ wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ wə·‘ā·śāh wə·hiš·ḥîṯ ‘ă·ṣū·mîm qə·ḏō·šîm wə·‘am-
verses.literal: His power will be great but it . . . will not be his own He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people

verses.original: וְעַל־ שִׂכְל֗וֹ בְּיָד֔וֹ מִרְמָה֙ וְהִצְלִ֤יחַ וּבִלְבָב֣וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּבְשַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְעַ֤ל־ שַׂר־ שָׂרִים֙ יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- śiḵ·lōw bə·yā·ḏōw mir·māh wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ ū·ḇil·ḇā·ḇōw yaḡ·dîl ū·ḇə·šal·wāh yaš·ḥîṯ rab·bîm ya·‘ă·mōḏ wə·‘al- śar- śā·rîm yiš·šā·ḇêr ū·ḇə·’e·p̄es yāḏ
verses.literal: Through his craft and by his hand he will cause deceit to prosper and in his own mind he will make himself great In a time of peace he will destroy many and he will even stand against the Prince of princes Yet he will be broken off but not by [human] hands

verses.original: וּמַרְאֵ֨ה הָעֶ֧רֶב וְהַבֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְאַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽחָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י רַבִּֽים׃ לְיָמִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ū·mar·’êh hā·‘e·reḇ wə·hab·bō·qer ’ă·šer ne·’ĕ·mar ’ĕ·meṯ hū wə·’at·tāh sə·ṯōm he·ḥā·zō·wn kî rab·bîm lə·yā·mîm
verses.literal: The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been spoken is true . . . Now you must seal up the vision for it concerns the distant future

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְנֶֽחֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָאָק֕וּם וָאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מְלֶ֣אכֶת וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל־ הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl nih·yê·ṯî wə·ne·ḥĕ·lê·ṯî yā·mîm wā·’ā·qūm wā·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ mə·le·ḵeṯ wā·’eš·tō·w·mêm ‘al- ham·mar·’eh wə·’ên mê·ḇîn
verses.literal: I Daniel was exhausted and lay ill for days Then I got up and went about - the king’s business I was confounded by the vision it was beyond understanding
